name: Warrior Spirit — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Warrior Spirit from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Spirit Warrior (Legendary Fighter Simple Archetype)" but are not part of the Warrior Spirit entry, which is unchanged.

A spirit warrior forges a mystical bond with a favored weapon, allowing him to unlock its spiritual power. The spirit warrior is able to draw out his weapon’s true magical potential in combat.

Spirit Weapon

Each day, a spirit warrior designates a weapon he is proficient with. He gains the following abilities while wielding this spirit weapon:

Eldritch Weapon (Su)

At 1st level, a spirit warrior gains the Arcane Strike feat, but he can only use this feat on his spirit weapon. He does not need to meet this feat’s prerequisites. In addition, three times per day as a standard action a spirit warrior can grant his spirit weapon a +1 enhancement bonus for 1 minute.

This ability replaces the spirit warrior’s 1st-level bonus feat.
